svg.title: Open proposals: three checks, one durable record
svg.desc: The model proposes an action from observations and replayable computations. Fact and feasibility errors block publication; strategy objections stay beside the proposal. Refused and unpublished proposals also enter the method record. Episode payoffs and forecast scores are separate from frozen prospective trials. Neither report automatically promotes a method or places an order.

text.tspan: A different strategy can still be a valid proposal.
Code checks facts and authority. The model owns the hypothesis.
Measured inputs + replayable calculations → hypothesis, action, size and forecast.
Registered setups and scores remain available as policy opinions.
Keep the proposal and its review
Frozen inputs, method text, forecasts and receipts; revisions append to the record.
Refused and unpublished proposals remain counted. Passing review is not execution.
One episode per group, net of assumed costs.
Forecast scores stay separate from payoff.
Policy agreement is not a causal comparison.
Same starting capital and declared costs.
Missing marks and failed arms stay visible.
Evidence for human review: no automatic method promotion, sizing or order placement.
